.create-or-alter function traffic_session_enriched_rt() {
    store_events_raw
    | where isnotempty(tenant_id) and isnotempty(store_id)
    | project
        tenant_id,
        store_id,
        window_start = iff(isnull(window_start), bin(timestamp, 5m), window_start),
        window_end = iff(isnull(window_end), bin(timestamp, 5m) + 5m, window_end),
        group_visitor_count = toint(coalesce(group_visitor_count, 0)),
        zone_id,
        zone_visitors = toint(coalesce(zone_visitors, 0)),
        dwell_seconds = todouble(coalesce(dwell_seconds, 0.0)),
        has_dwell_flag = iff(isnull(has_dwell_flag), todouble(coalesce(dwell_seconds, 0.0)) > 0.0, has_dwell_flag),
        zone_session_id,
        has_transaction_flag = false,
        max_dwell_bucket = iff(
            isnotempty(max_dwell_bucket),
            max_dwell_bucket,
            case(
                todouble(coalesce(dwell_seconds, 0.0)) < 30.0, "<30s",
                todouble(coalesce(dwell_seconds, 0.0)) < 60.0, "30-60s",
                todouble(coalesce(dwell_seconds, 0.0)) < 120.0, "60-120s",
                ">120s"
            )
        ),
        promo_zone_flag = tobool(coalesce(promo_zone_flag, false))
}
